gui_context: 只收录本轮实测的成就总览分类及等级奖励说明；Wiki 的成就详情子菜单过时且未实测，不照搬其中各项成就文案。

lines.raw: §7Challenge achievements may be completed a single time.
lines.text: Challenge achievements may be completed a single time.
lines.gloss: 一次性指每项挑战完成一次，不是整个玩法只能玩一次。
lines.zh: 每项挑战成就只能完成一次。

lines.raw: §7Tiered achievements are completed over multiple tiers.
lines.text: Tiered achievements are completed over multiple tiers.
lines.zh: 分级成就可依次完成多个阶段。

lines.raw: §7View challenge achievements for SkyBlock that are exclusive to seasonal events.
lines.text: View challenge achievements for SkyBlock that are exclusive to seasonal events.
lines.gloss: SkyBlock 留给名称开关处理。
lines.zh: 查看仅在 SkyBlock 季节活动中开放的挑战成就。

lines.context: 季节限定成就不计入总进度
lines.raw: §8These achievements do not count towards total game completion.
lines.text: These achievements do not count towards total game completion.
lines.gloss: 区别于普通成就解锁数。
lines.zh: 这些成就不计入游戏总完成度。

lines.context: 进阶之书升级为史诗稀有度
lines.raw: §7Your §fBook of Progression§7 will be upgraded to §5Epic§7.
lines.text: Your Book of Progression will be upgraded to Epic.
lines.gloss: 书名白色，史诗品质紫色；这是稀有度升级而非赠送新书。
lines.zh: 你的进阶之书将升级为史诗品质。
